title: Bulkhead (Day Lights)
medium: Lithograph in colors on wove paper

said.q: Commissioned by the United Nations in 1994, Robert Rauschenberg created Bulkhead (Day Lights) commemorating the UN's International Conference on Population and Development held in Cairo, Egypt from September 5-13 in 1994.
said.by: michael lisi / contemporary art, on Artsy
